headline: Building
AI that
helps.
intro: I'm Thanuja, a **Computer Science & Applied Mathematics** student at **Vanderbilt University** with a minor in **Engineering Management**. I build AI systems that turn messy data into decisions: a business-analytics assistant that cut manual processing in half, a recommendation engine that lifted campus engagement **62%**, and Kaggle models ranked in the **top 15% of 10,000+** competitors. Along the way, I've taught **1,000+** people to use AI through Thanuja.AI.

principles.text: Start from evidence. I published a study on convolutional neural networks and interviewed 5+ industry experts before writing a line of B.A.A.
Ship end-to-end systems that move real numbers: 37% faster client responses and 50% less manual work with B.A.A., and a 62% engagement lift with CampusConnect.AI.
Make AI accessible. 1,000+ learners through Thanuja.AI, 30+ peers mentored across schools, and 20+ coding workshops led.

points: Engineered an AI recommendation engine that personalizes event and club discovery from student profiles and event metadata.
Combined vector embeddings with collaborative filtering to improve the relevance and speed of suggestions.
Connected 200+ students and earned hundreds of sign-ups within weeks; presented to professors and secured commitments to expand.
